lines.text: Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem and sent messengers ahead into a village of the Samaritans.
The Samaritans refused to welcome Jesus, so James and John asked to call down hail from heaven.
Jesus rebuked James and John, and He and His disciples went on to another village.
Someone offered to follow Jesus anywhere, and Jesus said the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Jesus told a man who wanted to bury his father to go and wait in Jerusalem.
